name: DGB
recent: DGB 于 2025 年 11 月 10 日召开特别股东大会，股东通过削减 RM197,000,000 已发行股本的特别决议。此前公司于 10 月 29 日因 ESOS 行使发行 40,272,900 股新股。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过削减 RM197,000,000 已发行股本的特别决议。
因 ESOS 行使发行 40,272,900 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.035，并于 2025 年 10 月 29 日上市。
risks: ESOS 新股发行使已发行股本增至 330,516,179 股，对现有股东持股比例造成摊薄。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED REDUCTION OF RM197,000,000 OF THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF DGB ASIA BERHAD PURSUANT TO SECTION 117 OF THE COMPANIES ACT 2016 ("PROPOSED CAPITAL REDUCTION")

recent_en: DGB held an EGM on 10 Nov 2025 where shareholders approved a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by RM197,000,000. Earlier, 40,272,900 new shares were listed on 29 Oct 2025 under the ESOS. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: Shareholders passed a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by RM197,000,000 at the EGM.
40,272,900 new shares were issued under the ESOS at RM0.035 per share and listed on 29 Oct 2025.
risks_en: The ESOS share issuance increased issued shares to 330,516,179, diluting existing shareholders' stakes.
